reasons_add: Al-Tabrisi describes the bodily stretching as arising from listlessness.
Al-Tabrisi says the expression originally describes twisting one's back.
Al-Tabrisi also allows derivation from tamattuṭ, stretching, with a tāʾ changed to yāʾ, citing analogous forms.
Al-Tabrisi calls the exaggerated swaying walk al-muṭayṭāʾ and says it is prohibited.
